title: RevisionId
description: Canonical wire form of choirloom::score::RevisionId - a nominal, opaque 128-bit identity for project revisions. Lower-case UUIDv4-compatible string; equally non-ordering and intentionally distinct from EntityId. DRAFT / NON-FROZEN. Two-level validation: this schema enforces the syntactic pattern only; non-nil, exact 16-byte, and version/variant semantics are enforced by the core (RevisionId::from_string / RevisionId::from_bytes).
